_comment: skfem helmholtz#1: below 5 elements per wavelength the P1 phase velocity is visibly wrong. Verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1 on a one-element-thick MeshQuad strip (k=8, 4 wavelengths; 26 DOFs coarse, 642 finest) -- the cheapest geometry that reproduces 2D dispersion exactly, since for a y-constant field the Q1 tensor operator reduces to h_y*(K_x - k^2 M_x). At 3 elements/wavelength (k*h = 2.09 > 1) the discrete wavenumber is k_h/k = 0.879, i.e. the wave arrives 12% early; at 20 elements/wavelength the error is 0.41%; the error decays at rate ~2 in h over a 4-mesh sequence; and above k*h = 2*sqrt(3) the assembled operator admits NO propagating mode. k_h is measured twice independently -- as a root of the assembled interior stencil against a plane-wave ansatz and from the end-to-end driven solve -- and both match the analytic P1 relation cos(k_h h) = (1-(kh)^2/3)/(1+(kh)^2/6) to 1e-9. No measured floats are pinned.
